A '''data file viewer''' was a piece of equipment designed to allow individuals to view [[Datafile/Legends|datafiles]]. [[Bureaucrat/Legends|Bureaucrat]] offices in the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan/Legends|Aldera Royal Palace]] were equipped with data file viewers.
